name: Public one-line installer HTTP failure safety
target: Execute the documented public install command against a fake curl boundary and prove HTTP 504 cannot become success or start the installer.
inputs: fake HTTP 504 response with curl exit 22, a 504 body with curl exit 0 when -f is absent, and an empty error body with curl exit 0
observations: HTTP 504 is returned as non-zero and the installer is never started
an empty error response is rejected even if curl reports success
removing curl -f makes the 504 response exit differently and fails the simulation
empty and partial downloads are removed on failure
syntax checks and installer execution are recorded as distinct invocations
a valid download runs with --yes and is also removed afterward
